
== Japanese printing source audit ==
Added the original Japanese face from encyclopedia p. 42 (xref 2043, image SHA256 <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">53743a0e9c990b4a768e248616a282ea1b8106572ca225ad62dbf806cc7f6f82</code>). <ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 102. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The full original is [[:File:Japanese-ANH-Tantive-IV-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg]]. Printed wraps are joined and numeric/Latin glyphs normalized; underlined lore characteristics are retained. Counted the complete title and symbol groups. The English reading aid is tied to this source transcription. Both originals identify the ship as a capital corvette. The Japanese lore calls it a ship of the governor's house on Alderaan (総督家), where the English says "Royal House of Alderaan consular ship." The Japanese describes Leia's duties as an Imperial senator and the Rebels' secret missions, where the English says "Imperial Senate business" and "secret Rebel espionage." Both original game texts finish with deployment to any system. The Japanese parenthesis uses 人員とフォース・アイコン ("personnel and Force icons"), while the English says "presence or Force icons." Printed absence, rule-derived defaults and comparison-only English engine code are distinguished in the field audit. No Japanese GEMP implementation or new gameplay ruling is claimed.
